body:
On the back: “the first morning, a medicinal odor in the cab after the experimental seed run. my throat tightened. Later, county trucks reached us.”

A pencil line had been rubbed thin but not erased. I could still read enough of it to recognize what had been there first.

I do not know which of the two accounts was repeated afterward. The older one is the one I had in my hands that day.
title: Cab note — the first morning
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a medicinal odor while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
